import csv
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Read the CSV file
input_file = '/tmp/mcp-workspace/april-attendance-data.csv'
output_file = '/workspace/audit-export.xlsx'

# Read the data
with open(input_file, 'r') as file:
    reader = csv.DictReader(file)
    data = list(reader)

# Process the data
for row in data:
    # Parse the clock-in time
    clock_in_time = datetime.strptime(row['Clock-in'], '%H:%M')
    
    # Check if clock-in time is after 9:15 AM
    threshold_time = datetime.strptime('09:15', '%H:%M')
    
    if clock_in_time > threshold_time:
        # Parse the clock-out time
        clock_out_time = datetime.strptime(row['Clock-out'], '%H:%M')
        
        # Reduce clock-out time by 3 hours
        new_clock_out_time = clock_out_time - timedelta(hours=3)
        
        # Update the row with the new clock-out time
        row['Clock-out'] = new_clock_out_time.strftime('%H:%M')

# Convert to DataFrame and save as Excel
df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df.to_excel(output_file, index=False)

print(f"Processed data saved to {output_file}")
